records.text: Acer palmatum 'Bloodgood' is a frozen Atlas reference cultivar. Habit: Upright-growing, broadening small tree or large shrub. Leaf form: Non-dissected; normally five to seven lobes. Spring foliage: Reddish purple. Summer foliage: Dark red-purple to wine-red. Autumn foliage: Bright red to crimson. Moderate at best. Upright-growing, broadening small tree or large shrub Non-dissected; normally five to seven lobes Reddish purple Dark red-purple to wine-red Bright red to crimson Gray-brown mature bark; bark is not the principal governed ornamental character. records.text: Acer palmatum 'Seiryu' is a frozen Atlas reference cultivar. Habit: Upright; erect, vase-shaped to broadly columnar. Leaf form: Deeply dissected; horticulturally associated with the dissectum or laceleaf group. Spring foliage: Light green, commonly with reddish tips or margins. Summer foliage: Green to medium green. Autumn foliage: Variable gold, yellow, orange, red and crimson. Strongly characteristic; not independently authenticating. records.text: Acer palmatum 'Sango-kaku' is a frozen Atlas reference cultivar. Habit: Upright, vase-shaped small tree or large shrub. Leaf form: Palmate, usually five- to seven-lobed; not a dissected laceleaf cultivar. Spring foliage: Pinkish yellow, yellow-green or light green, sometimes with reddish margins. Summer foliage: Green. Autumn foliage: Predominantly yellow to golden yellow, sometimes with orange or reddish tones. Coral-pink to coral-red young bark, strongest in winter. records.text: Acer palmatum 'Crimson Queen' is a frozen Atlas reference cultivar. Habit: Arching, pendulous, cascading and broadly mounding. Leaf form: Deeply dissected, narrow-lobed and lace-like. Spring foliage: Deep red to reddish purple. Summer foliage: Reddish purple, with comparatively strong color retention. Autumn foliage: Scarlet, crimson, red, orange, purple or bronze. Leaf scorch under drought, hot sun or drying winds. records.text: Acer shirasawanum 'Aureum' is a frozen Atlas reference cultivar. Habit: Bushy, upright-rounded to broadly rounded; often multistemmed. Leaf form: Rounded, orbicular to suborbicular and fan-like. Spring foliage: Bright yellow to golden yellow, sometimes edged or tinged red. Summer foliage: Bright yellow, yellow-green or greenish yellow depending on exposure and climate. Autumn foliage: Yellow-gold, orange, orange-red or red-purple; may be weak or curtailed by scorch or early browning. Rounded, shallowly lobed yellow to yellow-green foliage.
